parts.text: Explain why migration caused by climate change is an important personal issue.

text: Study Sources 1 to 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘In the future, more people will migrate due to climate change.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘There are now more environmental disasters than in the past.’
How could you test this claim?
You should consider the types of information, sources of evidence and methods you might
use.

text: Study Source 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one prediction from Uki’s statement. Explain why it is a prediction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Pana is arguing that issues around environmental migration must be addressed by individuals.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Identify one opinion from Pana’s statement.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain how well this opinion supports Pana’s argument.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Uki’s or Pana’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different kinds of information used.

text: Study Source 4.
More people are now migrating due to the effects of climate change. The United Nations is
concerned about the problems this causes and is considering the following actions:
• Encourage governments to work together to reduce climate change.
• Plan new communities in safe places for migrants.
• Promote lifestyle changes that are better for the environment.
Which one of these actions would you recommend, and why?
In your answer, you should:
• state your recommendation
• give reasons and evidence to support your recommendation
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
• consider different arguments and perspectives.
